nodes.name: Add assets to project
nodes.description: Adds existing assets to a project in Vulcano

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Project id
inputs.description: Enter the id of the project the assets are added to — an unknown id creates that project

inputs.name: Asset ids
inputs.description: Enter the id of every asset to add to the project

inputs.name: Target location
inputs.description: Enter the folder inside the project to place the assets in

outputs.name: Project id
outputs.description: Returns the id of the project the assets were added to

outputs.name: Sent asset count
outputs.description: Returns how many asset ids were sent — Vulcano skips ids it does not know

outputs.name: Curl
outputs.description: Returns the curl command equivalent of the request

nodes.name: Create graphic
nodes.description: Creates a new asset from a template in Vulcano

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Template asset id
inputs.description: Enter the id of the template asset the graphic is created from

inputs.name: Vulcano user
inputs.description: Enter the Vulcano user the new graphic is created for

inputs.name: Graphic property values
inputs.description: Enter the property values to fill in, keyed by property id — leave empty to use the template defaults

inputs.name: Output file name
inputs.description: Enter the file name for the rendered graphic — leave empty to use the Vulcano naming pattern

inputs.name: Output duration seconds
inputs.description: Enter the render duration in seconds — 0 keeps the template duration

outputs.name: Graphic id
outputs.description: Returns the id of the newly created graphic

outputs.name: Graphic status
outputs.description: Returns the render status of the new graphic, for branching on the result

outputs.name: Graphic name
outputs.description: Returns the name of the newly created graphic

outputs.name: Graphic
outputs.description: Returns the full asset object from Vulcano

outputs.name: Curl
outputs.description: Returns the curl command equivalent of the request

nodes.name: Create ograf link
nodes.description: Creates a shareable OGraf player link for an asset in Vulcano

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Asset id
inputs.description: Enter the id of the asset to share — it must have an OGraf bundle

inputs.name: Link expiry days
inputs.description: Enter the number of days the link stays valid, between 1 and 365

inputs.name: Link label
inputs.description: Enter a label to recognise the link by in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Link control values
inputs.description: Enter the control values the player starts with (JSON object)

outputs.name: Link id
outputs.description: Returns the id of the new link, to revoke it later

outputs.name: Link token
outputs.description: Returns the token that grants access to the shared graphic

outputs.name: Player url
outputs.description: Returns the ready to share OGraf player url for the asset

outputs.name: Ograf link
outputs.description: Returns the full link object from Vulcano

outputs.name: Curl
outputs.description: Returns the curl command equivalent of the request

nodes.name: Create vgg project
nodes.description: Creates a Video Graphic Generator project from a video in Vulcano

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Video file path
inputs.description: Enter the absolute path of the video file to use as the base video

inputs.name: Project name
inputs.description: Enter the name of the new project — leave empty to use the video file name

inputs.name: Project id
inputs.description: Enter the id of the new project — leave empty to generate a fresh draft id

outputs.name: Project id
outputs.description: Returns the id of the new project, to wire into later packaging steps

outputs.name: Project name
outputs.description: Returns the name of the new project

outputs.name: Base video path
outputs.description: Returns the server side path the uploaded video was stored at

outputs.name: Project
outputs.description: Returns the full project object from Vulcano

outputs.name: Curl
outputs.description: Returns the curl command equivalent of the request that saved the project

nodes.name: Download highres file
nodes.description: Downloads the high resolution file of an asset from Vulcano

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Asset id
inputs.description: Enter the id of the asset to download the high resolution file of

inputs.name: Target folder
inputs.description: Enter the absolute path of the folder to save the file in

inputs.name: File name
inputs.description: Enter the file name to save the download as

inputs.name: Duplicate file option
inputs.description: Choose how to handle an existing file with the same name

outputs.name: File path
outputs.description: Returns the final path of the downloaded file

outputs.name: File size
outputs.description: Returns the size of the downloaded file in bytes

nodes.name: List templates
nodes.description: Lists the templates in a Vulcano template folder

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Template folder id
inputs.description: Enter the folder to list, including its subfolders — an unknown folder returns nothing

inputs.name: Search query
inputs.description: Enter a search query to keep only templates matching it

inputs.name: Max results
inputs.description: Enter the maximum number of templates to return

inputs.name: Sort by
inputs.description: Choose the field to sort the templates by

inputs.name: Sort direction
inputs.description: Choose whether to sort the templates ascending or descending

outputs.name: Total count
outputs.description: Returns how many templates the folder holds in total, for empty-result branching

outputs.name: Template ids
outputs.description: Returns the id of every template returned, to wire into Create graphic

outputs.name: Template names
outputs.description: Returns the name of every template returned

outputs.name: Templates
outputs.description: Returns the full array of templates from Vulcano

outputs.name: Curl
outputs.description: Returns the curl command equivalent of the request

nodes.name: Upload mogrt
nodes.description: Uploads a mogrt file to a template folder in Vulcano

inputs.name: Vulcano url
inputs.description: Enter the base url of the Vulcano instance

inputs.name: Api token
inputs.description: Enter the service token generated in the Vulcano user interface

inputs.name: Tree node id
inputs.description: Enter the id of the template tree node to upload into — an unknown id creates that folder

inputs.name: Mogrt file path
inputs.description: Enter the absolute path of the mogrt file to upload

outputs.name: Uploaded file name
outputs.description: Returns the file name the mogrt was stored under in Vulcano

outputs.name: File size
outputs.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes
